items.intro_en: From 2014 he called AI humanity's biggest existential risk and pushed for regulation, co-founded OpenAI in 2015, then launched xAI in 2023 to build it himself.
items.intro_zh: 从2014年起，他称人工智能是人类最大的生存风险，并推动对其监管；2015年联合创立OpenAI，随后于2023年创办xAI，亲自打造人工智能。

items.title_zh: 火星与成为多行星物种
items.intro_en: The founding idea of SpaceX in 2002: make life multiplanetary as a backup for civilisation. The target date for the first trip has moved many times.
items.intro_zh: 2002年创立SpaceX的初衷：让生命成为多行星存在，作为人类文明的备份。首次旅程的目标日期已多次变动。

items.intro_en: Once a footnote, falling birth rates became one of his most repeated themes from around 2017, framed as a bigger threat than climate change.
items.intro_zh: 出生率下降曾只是不起眼的注脚，但从2017年前后起成为他反复提及的主题之一，并被描述为比气候变化更大的威胁。

items.intro_en: The stated reason for buying Twitter in 2022. The theme grows sharply from that year, along with fights with governments and advertisers.
items.intro_zh: 这是他2022年收购Twitter时给出的理由。自那一年起，这一主题显著增多，同时他也与政府和广告商发生冲突。

items.intro_en: Tesla's mission as he wrote it: accelerate the transition to sustainable energy. He long backed a carbon tax, then spoke more of keeping oil and gas for now.
items.intro_zh: 他笔下的特斯拉使命：加速向可持续能源转型。他长期支持碳税，后来更多谈到暂时保留石油和天然气。

items.intro_en: Promised as near every year since 2015; the most-tracked series of predictions in his career.
items.intro_zh: 自2015年以来几乎每年都作出承诺；这是他职业生涯中被追踪最多的系列预测。

items.intro_en: From a CEO wary of red tape to running DOGE in 2025 inside the Trump administration, then leaving it after four months.
items.intro_zh: 从一位警惕繁文缛节的CEO，到2025年在特朗普政府内执掌DOGE，四个月后离开。

items.intro_en: The simulation hypothesis, expanding the « scope and scale of consciousness », and later a growing interest in religion.
items.intro_zh: 模拟假说、扩大“意识的范围与规模”，以及后来对宗教日益增长的兴趣。
